name: Vow of the First Lands
blurb: Innate:  Yunara's  critical strikes deal bonus magic damage.

effects.description: Innate: Yunara's critical strikes deal 10% (+ 10% per 100 AP) bonus magic damage.

notes:
The bonus damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike pre-mitigation.
If Yunara critically strikes against a champion that has  Randuin's Omen, the bonus magic damage from Vow of the First Lands and the bonus magic damage on-hit from  Cultivation of Spirit will both be reduced by 30%.(unexpected)
This can result in a critical strike yielding less bonus magic damage than if the basic attack had not critically struck.
